=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:Every job in GATED_JOBS (`tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`, `tests-promote-stall-and-review`, `tests-release-and-log-analysis`, `orchestrate-poll`, `tests-system-python`, `tests-sandbox-python`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The gated jobs declare `needs: tests-main-delta` and use `!cancelled()` in `if:`. The reviewer says this does not override GitHub's rule that a job is skipped when a job it needs is skipped, so the gated jobs are skipped whenever `tests-main-delta` is skipped (stable branch pushes, or `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED=false`).
  WHY: These seven test jobs would be skipped on any push branch other than `main` and whenever `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` is `false`, which turns off most of the CI suite in those cases. The source severity was BLOCKER, mapped here to critical. The other four reviewers checked the same `needs:`/`if:` wiring and reported no issue.
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:Around line 160 (runs read loop) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If the script is cancelled or fails during the `gh api` runs read, the temporary error log file (`read_err_file`) is not removed.
  WHY: It leaves an unneeded temp file in the runner's short-lived workspace. This is minor hygiene, not a production correctness bug (source severity NIT).
- scripts/ci_main_delta.sh:tests-main-delta job steps | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `tests-main-delta` job installs only the Python CI dependencies and leaves out the Node.js/wrangler environment that some gated test jobs need.
  WHY: A selected test that needs Node/wrangler fails loudly inside the delta job. That is not a silent pass, but it may delay detection of failures in those tests (source severity NIT).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:Job comment on tests-main-delta (approx. line 5127) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The job comment still says the base is the "newest successful" run, which contradicts the updated red-wins rule (a red base stays red until a green run that started after it has finished).
  WHY: The comment no longer matches the code, but this does not affect how the job runs (source severity NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A switch restores today's behaviour." (Goal 7)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml and lint aggregate logic
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Setting `MAIN_PUSH_DELTA_CI_ENABLED=false` skips the `tests-main-delta` job. The gated test jobs `need` `tests-main-delta` and have no logic for its skipped state, so they are skipped too. The reviewer says this loses the whole CI test suite on `main` instead of falling back to the full suite as intended (source severity BLOCKER).
- requirement: "Nothing in code enforces 'no promotion without a full run from the same day'." (Rollout watch requirement)
  expected_change_site: Not required for runtime correctness as the 22:30 UTC scheduled full run mitigates the risk, but the issue listed this as a rollout watch item.
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No code guard or alert enforces that a nightly promotion has a full suite run before it on the same day (source severity NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
